_about: Startup JS + CSS budget of index.html in bytes, checked by tools/check-size.js (definition in its header). 2.0 was 1,569,203 bytes; 2.1 adds 11,962 (the import progress through every step, the report's collapse and toggle, the version beside the name, their strings and icons): 1,581,165, rounded up to the next 5 kB. 2.3 adds the Settings choice for cells merged over rows and the Word / HTML importer's filled-out table grid: 1,584,772, within the same budget. The PDF importer loads on demand; the builders (PowerPoint included) still load at startup — loading them on first use (TODO.md, High) lowers it. 2.4: raised to 1,595,000 (+10 KB, the owner's decision, 2026-11-09) for the page items of 2.4 — the tagline's icon, the export buttons by mode, the Word settings header, the slide-format check (its rules loaded only on switching to slides); 2.3 had left 82 bytes. Then 1,600,000 (+5 KB, the owner's decision, 2026-11-09) for the slides preview's progress bar (PptxBuilder's progress and chunked layout, the bar, its words): the slides view loads with the page, so nothing of it could load on demand — loading the whole slides view on demand is planned for 2.5. Then 1,601,000 (+1 KB, the owner's offer, 2026-11-09): one progress window across the app — the slides preview's progress moves into the task window, shown without making it modal (a task takes it over); the in-pane bar's markup and styles go. 2.5: 1,602,500 (+1.5 KB, asked of the owner with this pull request, 2026-11-09) for the slide check after a paste or an import in Slides and before a PPTX export: its hooks in the editor, the importer, the exporter and the Slides view (the check, its words and its report stay in scripts/slidecheck.js, loaded on demand). Then 1,606,000 (+3.5 KB, asked of the owner with this pull request, 2026-11-09) for Settings → Fonts: one font choice for every output and its resolution per output (Kelk.settings.fontsFor), the fonts of their own for DOCX and PPTX, the schema-2 migration, the fonts shown from their PDF font files (Kelk.fonts.fromPdf), the pane's fields and words. Then 1,606,500 (+0.5 KB) for the B fonts' entries in scripts/config.js (removed with them). Then 1,609,000 (+2.5 KB, the owner's approval, 2026-11-09): the red «not installed» note asking for the system font itself (FontFace local()) with its words, the first slides build's window opening at once, a slides build stopping outside Slides. Then 1,613,500 (+4.5 KB, the owner's approval, 2026-11-09): fonts embedded in DOCX and PPTX — the option, the step that picks the fonts a file uses and loads their TrueType files (Kelk.fonts.embed), the export's message, the B fonts' character set and the publisher's website button; the embedding itself (lib/FontEmbed.js) loads on demand. 2.6: 1,630,000 (+16.5 KB, asked of the owner with this pull request, 2026-11-09) for the Excel view: its toggle button, the XLSX and CSV export buttons, the pane, Settings → Excel (about 50 fields' words in three languages: most of the increase), the XLSX fonts in Settings → Fonts, the view switch across three views and the XLSX / CSV export hooks. The view itself (scripts/sheets.js, lib/XlsxBuilder.js) and SheetJS load on demand. 2.6, pull request 2: Settings → Excel's words moved to the Excel module (−6.5 KB) and the CSV / XLSX import's hooks in the importer, the order dialog and the page (+6 KB) took that room: the budget stays at 1,630,000. 2.6, the Excel view's paste and sample: 1,633,000 (+3 KB, asked of the owner with this pull request, 2026-11-10) for the paste hooks in the Excel view (CSV text becomes a table, a paste with tables shows the summary: the editor's paste, the Paste button, the view's check), the samples as one table per view (the Excel sample's wiring and its two sentences in three languages), the dark theme's color helpers shared with the Excel view, and the longer tagline and placeholder. The sample itself and the code behind each hook load on demand. 2.6 fixes: 1,634,000 (+1 KB, asked of the owner with the pull request, 2026-11-10): the longer reportOpenMs comment in scripts/config.js (every report, not only PDF's) and the timer custom reports now start (scripts/report.js) went 91 bytes over. 2.7: 1,646,000 (+12 KB, asked of the owner with this pull request, 2026-11-11) for named progress everywhere (the rule since 2.7: every progress state names its step): the step helper shared by every task (Kelk.ui.steps, moved out of scripts/slides.js), the empty-step guard, the library check behind «first time only» (Kelk.libs.loaded), each import's and export's steps, and their names in three languages (about 5.5 kB of the increase). The importer's and the Excel module's own steps load on demand with them.
